title: 95% of botting is solved by blizzard hiring a few human GMs

posts.cooked:
All these threads about GDKPs banned and RMT prevention etc.

Stop making excuses for Blizzard. RMT was rare in original game 20 years ago because of the times, but also because Blizzard had active HUMAN gamemasters.

Yes i’ll say it, Blizzard is a lazy, cheap and greedy corp that doesn’t want to front up ANY money for real humans to monitor the worlds and realms.

1 game master can teleport anywhere in the world and ban hundreds of bots in an hour, it’s so simple.

“Oh no but $25 an hour we have to pay them, we should automate it!”, ok but Blizzard your automation sucks, people get banned for no reason, and there are still bots EVERYWHERE. I’m sure most people reading this thread could identify and ban at least 50 bots in an hour if you had GM abilities.

Blizzard, stop being cheap and just pay gamemasters.

posts.name: Sawyer
posts.cooked:
It’s 2025. People still making posts talking about hiring GMs to do manual labor in the age of AI.

There’s an evolutionary divide between people who still talk about this as if it has a chance of ever happening, and people who understand the 3 trillion dollar AI company is never hiring people for such menial tasks, and that if they ever truly wanted to ban bots, they would have already done so without a single human observer.

Similar evolutionary divides are observable in real life. For example those who leave their blinker on while driving. Those who don’t understand marginal tax brackets. Those who think their side of the political clown show is the good one, and the other side is evil.

I could go on, but here on these forums, it’s people thinking GMs will ever be a thing again.

What are you on about? You think Blizzard has AI that can act and be more efficient than a human GM right now? No they don’t.

They’re lazy and cheap, they’ve automated the GM role all these years and it’s horrible and doesn’t solve the problem or even improve it.

Could they use AI and actually be effective? Yes.
Do they? No.

Practical over theoretical, human GM will solve 95% of the problem tomorrow whereas AI will take time.
